title: Fade out with TweenService
prompt:
Write a ModuleScript that returns a table with a function `fadeOut(part: BasePart, duration: number): Tween`.
It uses TweenService to tween the part's Transparency to 1 over `duration` seconds with Linear easing, starts the
tween and returns it. When the tween completes, the part's CanCollide becomes false.
